VC&M — Volumetric Clouds & Mist

Reference Last updated: 2026-11-18

Legacy host. The active Rust/Iced Doppio does not load C++ plugins. These pages document the C++/ImGui plugin SDK and its host in the archived C++ editor (doppio-archived/). The engine still builds every plugin from the submodule so the SDK stays compile-tested.

The VC&M plugin authors volumetric clouds and ground mist through a weather model and a panel for the legacy C++ host.

VC&M is a plugin for the legacy C++/ImGui host that procedurally authors volumetric clouds and ground mist. The plugin owns the weather model and the authoring UI; the engine ray-marches the cloud layer in the sky pass.

What it does#

  • Generates a weather profile from humidity, instability, wind and a seed.
  • Ray-marches a 3D value-noise FBM cloud layer between two altitudes.
  • Marches toward the sun for self-shadowing and scattering.
  • Adds ground mist that also feeds the engine's scene volumetric fog, so geometry is wrapped in the same haze.
  • Provides an Inspector drawer for the VolumetricCloudsComponent.

Presets#

Preset Look
Fair weather Sparse, high, soft clouds
Cumulus Puffy mid-level clouds with strong detail
Overcast Dense, low, flat layer
Storm Thick dark cells, high wind and detail
Misty morning Low coverage with strong valley mist
Alpine High base, crisp detail, light mist
Clear sky Disables the layer

How the algorithm maps weather#

Input Effect
Humidity Coverage, density, lower base, thicker layer, more mist
Instability Detail octaves and vertical development
Wind speed / direction Drift of the procedural field
Seed Shifts the 3D noise field
Quality Ray-march steps: Low 8, Medium 16, High 24

The plugin writes a VolumetricCloudsComponent on the selected entity (or a dedicated Volumetric Clouds entity). The engine resolves the component once per frame and uploads it to the sky shader.

Installing#

bash
./scripts/submodules.sh

cmake -S doppio-plugins -B doppio-plugins/build \
  -DCAFFEINE_ROOT="$PWD" \
  -DIMGUI_DIR="$PWD/build/_deps/imgui-src"
cmake --build doppio-plugins/build --target volumetric_clouds_plugin
cp doppio-plugins/build/plugins/volumetric_clouds_plugin.so build/plugins/

Enable VC&M in the legacy host's Plugins → Plugin Manager, then use Plugins → Create Volumetric Clouds & Mist (creates the component, enables it and opens the panel) or View → Volumetric Clouds & Mist.

Quick Search#

Press Ctrl+P, type clouds, and run Add Volumetric Clouds. If nothing is selected, VC&M creates and selects an entity, adds the component with a usable Cumulus profile and enables the layer. Run Plugins → Create Volumetric Clouds & Mist to do the same and open the panel.

Usage#

  1. Select an entity, or let VC&M create a dedicated atmosphere entity.
  2. Pick a preset and tune humidity/instability.
  3. Press Generate.
  4. Switch the viewport to 3D and look toward the sky.
  5. Tune the cloud layer and mist values directly; the viewport updates live.

Performance#

High quality uses 24 ray-march steps plus 4 sun-march steps. Use Medium while editing and High for captures. The cloud pass only shades sky pixels; it is skipped for rays below the horizon.
